Name: Horse Master - Summon Horse and Dynamic Speed Control - Horse Flute Summon Horse Speed
Author: ZeroXPatch
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Horse Master[/size][/b][/center]
[i]Your horse is more than just a vehicle—it's your partner. Horse Master allows you to customize your riding speed to be faster, slower, or dynamically linked to your farmer's physical condition.
[/i]

[quote]Safe to uninstall anytime. Removing it just disables the features.

[size=3][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements][size=3]https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ZeroXPatch/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=endorsements[/size][/url][/quote]


[b][size=4]Description
[/size][/b]
Horse Master is a lightweight mod that gives you full control over horse movement speed. You can choose between a simple, constant speed boost or an immersive "Adaptive Mode" where your horse's performance reflects your current energy levels.

[center]﻿[youtube]U_RHn7hPTVM[/youtube][/center]

[b][size=4]Features[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=2]1.1 Update: Added in a Summon Horse, you can summon horse now:3 Also the horse summoned will be right under you, you dont even need to click to ride![/size][/color]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Ride Faster (or Slower):[/b] Configure speed boosts from -5 (sluggish) all the way to +10 (lightning fast).
[/list][list]
[*][b]Adaptive Energy System:[/b] An optional mode where Horse speed changes automatically as your farmer gets tired throughout the day.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Instant Response:[/b] Speed changes apply instantly when mounting or dismounting. No sliding or "sticky" speed buffs while walking.
[/list][list]
[*][b]Lag Free:[/b] Optimized code ensures zero impact on game performance.
[/list][center]﻿﻿[/center]﻿[b][size=4]Game Modes
[/size][/b]
You can switch between these modes in the config menu:

[b]1. Constant Mode
[/b]
Simple and effective. Set a specific speed boost (e.g., +3), and your horse will always travel at that speed, regardless of how tired you are or what time it is.

[b]2. Adaptive Mode
[/b]

[list]
[*][b]100% Player Energy:[/b] (Default: +1 Speed)
[*][b]99% - 70% Player Energy:[/b] (Default: +2 Speed)
[*][b]69% - 40% Player Energy:[/b]  (Default: +3 Speed)
[*][b]39% - 10% Player Energy:[/b] . (Default: +4Speed)
[*][b]0% - 9% Player Energy:[/b] (Default: +10 Speed)
[/list][i]All values above are fully configurable!

[center]﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/41699/41699-1769650841-716452108.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[/i]
[b][size=4]Requirements
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (Required to change settings)
[/list][b][size=4]Installation
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod.
[*]Unzip the [b]HorseMaster[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] directory.
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI.
[/list][b][size=4]How to Use
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Configuration:[/b] Open the Generic Mod Config Menu (the gear icon on the title screen or in the in-game options tab).
[*][b]Debug Mode:[/b] Check the "Debug Mode" box to see a display above your player's head showing exactly which speed buff is active and your precise energy percentage.
[/list][b][size=4]Compatibility
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+.
[*]Multiplayer compatible (Client-side only). Each player can have their own speed settings without affecting others.
[*]Compatible with texture replacements for horses.
[/list]
